description: This file defines the MysqliManager class, a PHP class implementing MySQL database management using the mysqli extension. It extends MysqlManager and provides methods for executing queries, managing connections, retrieving database info, and comparing variable definitions, specifically tailored for the mysqli extension.

classes.name: MysqliManager
classes.description: A PHP class implementing MySQL database management using the mysqli extension, providing methods for query execution, connection handling, and database info retrieval.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Executes a SQL query, handling both string and array inputs, with logging and error checking.

methods.name: getAffectedRowCount
methods.description: Returns the number of rows affected by the last query.

methods.name: getRowCount
methods.description: Returns the number of rows in a result set.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Closes the database connection and frees resources.

methods.name: getFieldsArray
methods.description: Retrieves an array of field names from a result set.

methods.name: fetchRow
methods.description: Fetches a single row from a result set as an associative array.

methods.name: quote
methods.description: Escapes a string for safe use in SQL queries.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a database connection using configuration options, sets charset and collation, and handles errors.

methods.name: lastDbError
methods.description: Returns the last database error message, if any.

methods.name: getDbInfo
methods.description: Returns information about the database connection and server.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Checks if the mysqli extension is available and not disabled in configuration.

methods.name: compareVarDefs
methods.description: Compares two variable definitions, with special handling for 'int' types in newer MySQL versions.
